Can a Class 11 student use this application?

No. This SC pre-matric route is for Classes 9 and 10. A Class 11 student should look for the appropriate post-matric option in the scholarship directory and confirm its current rules.

Does the ₹2.5 lakh limit refer to monthly income?

No. It is the parent or guardian’s annual income ceiling.

Is 15 November the application deadline?

No. NSP lists 31 October 2026 for student applications. The later November dates concern verification.

Is the scholarship amount guaranteed when I submit?

No. Submission is not a sanction or payment confirmation. The applicable DNHDD award rate also needs clarification because the linked specifications and current national schedule differ.

Should I create another OTR for renewal?

NSP describes OTR as a number for the student’s entire academic career. Use the existing registration and follow the renewal route where applicable.

title: ICAR JRF/SRF PhD Fellowship 2026-27: How the Award Is Decided
eligibility: For the ICAR AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD) route, candidates need a qualifying Master’s degree in the subject accepted for their chosen doctoral discipline. The 2026-27 ICAR counselling brochure sets subject-specific qualifications in Annexure IV. A fellowship depends on exam merit, ICAR counselling, eligible university admission and document verification. A Bachelor’s degree alone does not qualify someone for this doctoral award.
description:
A PhD seat and an ICAR fellowship do not arrive as one automatic package. The entrance score gets a candidate into the admission process; ICAR makes the funding decision after counselling. That distinction matters when you are deciding whether you can afford to accept an allotment.

Which applicants is this fellowship for?

The 2026-27 route is linked to ICAR’s AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD) examination. You need a qualifying Master’s degree that matches the doctoral subject you choose. ICAR lists the acceptable Master’s subjects in Annexure IV of its official PhD counselling brochure. The brochure also warns that a three-year Bachelor’s degree does not generally meet its PhD admission rule, with narrow exceptions at IARI and NDRI. Check your exact degree combination before filling university choices.

How is the fellowship awarded?

ICAR bases the JRF/SRF award on merit in the 2026 doctoral entrance examination. The brochure says the fellowship is allotted only after online counselling, subject to admission at an eligible agricultural university and verification of credentials. A counselling rank or seat by itself is not an award letter. The fellowship lasts up to three years and cannot be held alongside another scholarship or fellowship from the same period under ICAR’s conditions. The amount should be taken from the applicable official award terms, not from an unverified listing.

What should a 2026 candidate do now?

The entrance registration stage is over. The NTA ICAR page carries the 2026 PhD scorecard and result notices; the ICAR counselling notice page carries current admission instructions. Keep your rank card, filled choices, allotment letter and any fellowship award letter. ICAR cautions that some downloads may not remain available after the counselling portal closes. There is no separate NSP application route established in the current ICAR documents.

Students seeking support for a Master’s course should not use this PhD route as a substitute. The ICAR NTS-PG scholarship addresses a different stage of study.

Questions applicants often ask

Does a PhD seat guarantee ICAR JRF/SRF funding?

No. ICAR ties the award to examination merit and the completed counselling and admission process. Read the fellowship outcome separately from the seat allotment.

Can I apply with only a Bachelor’s degree?

No. This doctoral pathway calls for a qualifying Master’s degree in the relevant subject. The official brochure also has course-specific Bachelor’s degree rules, so check both qualifications.

Is there a separate NSP fellowship form?

The official 2026 documents route candidates through the ICAR doctoral examination and ICAR counselling. They do not establish a separate NSP application for this award.

meta_description: ICAR’s JRF/SRF PhD fellowship is decided after entrance-exam merit and counselling, not through a separate NSP form. Learn who can qualify and what an award depends on.
page_summary:
An ICAR AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD) score can lead to a doctoral seat without guaranteeing a fellowship. For 2026-27, ICAR’s PhD counselling brochure says the award is decided by entrance-exam merit and finalized after online counselling, admission at an eligible agricultural university and document checks. If you are comparing funding options, treat the rank card, seat allotment and fellowship award letter as different documents.

This is a PhD route for applicants with a qualifying Master’s degree, not a scholarship that a student can secure after a Bachelor’s degree alone. The accepted Master’s subjects depend on the doctoral discipline. Check Annexure IV of the brochure before selecting university choices. If your Master’s subject does not match the chosen PhD discipline, an exam score alone will not make you eligible. A student may receive an ICAR quota seat without the fellowship, so do not budget on the stipend until an award is confirmed.

The 2026 entrance application period has passed. NTA’s ICAR portal now lists 2026 scorecards, while ICAR publishes counselling notices separately. There is no separate NSP form established for this fellowship. If you are in the 2026 counselling pool, check your rank card, subject eligibility and the latest ICAR notice. If you need funding for a Master’s programme instead, our ICAR NTS-PG guide covers a different award route.

description:
Plan the college handover before submitting

The 2026-27 departmental notice sets four deadlines:

  • 20 November: student online application.

  • 25 November: printout and documents to the institution.

  • 28 November: institutional scrutiny and online approval.

  • 30 November: approved applications must reach the Directorate.

Ask the office where to submit your file and how to confirm receipt. Keep a copy of everything you hand over. This makes it easier to resolve a missing page or an unclear scan before the institute finishes verification.

Prepare the application file

The checklist includes the registration printout, SSLC marksheet, ITI admission and fee records, your own bank passbook, Aadhaar, nativity and community/minority certificates, original income certificate and ration card. Second-year students must apply afresh and provide first-year marks or the prescribed certificate when marks are unavailable.

Compare names and bank details across your records before uploading. If something differs, ask the institute which supporting document or correction it needs.

Use the department’s portal

Register or log in at the Minority Welfare scholarship portal. Complete your profile, institution details and qualifications, choose the scheme and upload the required documents. The portal advises checking every entry before final submission because later editing may not be available.

Use Submitted Applications to follow progress, and keep the application reference with your document copies.

Questions before you apply

What should I confirm with my ITI first?

Ask the office to confirm that its recognition and your course match the official notice. Then agree on a date for handing over your file.

Should I wait until the online deadline to start?

Leave time for certificates, readable scans and corrections. An early document check can prevent a last-minute problem.

How should I keep track of my submission?

Save the application reference, submitted form and supporting files together. Record when you gave the paper copies to the institute.

Explore other scholarships on DekhoCampus separately; each programme has its own rules.

title: Vahani Scholarship 2026: Apply by 1 November for Undergraduate Support

description:
If college costs are a concern while you prepare for Class 12 boards, Vahani Scholarship offers support for undergraduate study. The Trust has opened applications for 2026, with a deadline of 1 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Start with the official announcement and allow time to complete every section.

Check your eligibility before registering

You must be studying in Class 12, have scored at least 85% in the Class 10 board examination and have annual family income below ₹3 lakh. The programme is for students planning undergraduate study in India.

Understand the support and its conditions

The award covers full tuition and provides additional help with study and living costs, including books, accommodation, food, travel and a laptop stipend. It is not advertised as one fixed cash amount for everyone.

An offer after selection is conditional on achieving at least 87% in Class 12. Scholars must obtain the Vahani Board’s approval for their chosen institution before admission. Read the Trust’s scholarship conditions before committing to a college.

Complete the application, not just registration

  1. Open the official registration portal and create your account.

  2. Sign in and start the application. Complete the personal, family, academic, college-preference and other requested sections.

  3. Write the essay yourself. You can save sections and return later.

  4. Review the completed form, submit it and retain the confirmation email. Only fully completed applications are considered.

The application is free. The official admission guide explains the process. For other options, explore scholarships on DekhoCampus.

Questions before you apply

Does an 85% Class 10 score guarantee the scholarship?

No. It meets the stated academic threshold for applying; it is not an award guarantee.

Can I choose any college after selection?

You must get the Vahani Board’s approval before taking admission. Do not assume every institution is covered.

Is creating an account enough?

No. Complete and submit the application, then retain the confirmation email.

title: MEA Scholarship 2026: Houston association lists 30 November deadline
amount: US$600 per year, with renewal subject to academic performance
eligibility: First-year students of Kerala origin pursuing an eligible four- or five-year bachelor’s degree in India. Applicants need marks above 85% in both Classes 10 and 12, a KEAM rank within the top 7,000 or a NATA score above 110 for B.Arch, and combined parental income below ₹1.5 lakh a year from all sources. Lateral-entry students and students already in later years cannot apply.
deadline: 30 November 2026 on the application page; PDF still lists 1 November
description:
Use the 2026 application page to reach MEA Houston’s form. The page lists 30 November as the deadline for receipt of applications, but the applicant guide still carries the earlier 1 November cutoff. MEA does not give a closing hour on the current page.

Submitting the online form does not deliver your supporting documents. Email them separately as instructed and ask the scholarship team to confirm your file is complete.

Who the scholarship supports

The Malayalee Engineers’ Association is based in Houston, Texas. Its scholarship supports students of Kerala origin whose academic record is strong but whose family finances make professional education difficult. Eligible studies lead to a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Architecture or Naval Architecture at a nationally accredited engineering college or university in India.

You must be in the first year of an eligible course lasting at least four years, or five years for B.Arch. This is not a new-entry scholarship for students already in their second, third or fourth year. Admission through lateral entry after a diploma or another degree is also excluded.

Check the marks, entrance result and income together

  • Marks must be above 85% in both Class 10 and Class 12.

  • The entrance requirement is a KEAM rank within the top 7,000, or a NATA score greater than 110 for B.Arch applicants.

  • Combined parental income must be below ₹1,50,000 a year, counting all sources.

Meeting only one academic condition is not enough. The 2026 applicant guide requires both the school marks and the applicable entrance result. Disclose any other scholarship you have accepted; do not leave it out because it pays a different expense.

What US$600 a year means

Selected students receive US$600 annually, alongside mentorship. The programme provides renewal over four or five years of study, subject to satisfactory performance. Selection depends on academic merit and financial need, so eligibility does not guarantee an award.

For renewal, the guide requires passing all examinations and a GPA of at least 7.0 or equivalent. The committee may relax the B.Arch requirement to at least 6.5 at its discretion. Semester marksheets must be sent promptly; the guide warns that failure to send them within a month of results can end renewal eligibility. Scholars must also disclose other financial support each year. An education loan does not itself disqualify an applicant.

The online form is only one part of the file

Follow the form linked from MEA’s official page and email the supporting documents as instructed. Prepare these before attempting a last-day submission:

  • Self-attested Class 10 and 12 marksheets, plus the relevant entrance marksheet and rank certificate or NATA scorecard.

  • An income certificate covering all sources, issued by the Tahsildar or Village Officer.

  • A statement explaining the work of parents or guardians who are daily-wage workers, labourers, or engaged in agriculture, trade or business.

  • Details of awards and extracurricular honours, and a ration-card copy if you are in the BPL category.

  • A personal explanation of financial hardship or special circumstances, plus details of other scholarships, grants or non-repayable awards.

Email the documents to MEA’s scholarship address, preferably as PDFs, using the same email account for subsequent correspondence. Include the scholarship year and your name in the subject, and identify each document and your full name in the filenames. Follow the guide’s signing, dating and attestation instructions and retain copies.

A recommendation from your Class 10 or 12 principal, headmaster or teacher is requested after shortlisting. Contact MEA if a document is difficult to obtain; do not assume it has been waived. Students comparing financial support can also use the scholarship directory.

Questions before applying

Can I apply after joining engineering through lateral entry?

No. The 2026 guide excludes lateral-entry admissions after a diploma or another degree. It also excludes new applications from students already in later years.

Does 85% in Class 12 alone meet the marks rule?

No. MEA requires marks above 85% in both Classes 10 and 12, alongside the applicable KEAM or NATA condition and the income requirement.

Why does the PDF give a different deadline?

The PDF still gives 1 November, while the association’s current application page lists 30 November 2026. MEA does not explain the difference. Send both parts promptly and contact the association if you need confirmation for your application.

description:
Check your institution’s location first

The Focus Area Science Technology Summer Fellowship is jointly offered by the Indian Academy of Sciences, Bengaluru; Indian National Science Academy, New Delhi; and National Academy of Sciences, India, Prayagraj. Its 2027 round supports students and teachers studying or working in the following regions:

  • Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura.

  • Andaman, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh and Uttarakhand.

  • The Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.

The condition concerns where you study or teach. Do not assume that a home address in one of these regions qualifies you if your institution is elsewhere. Check the official application instructions before starting.

Match your course with the permitted year

What the fellowship pays for

Selected applicants work with their assigned guide for two months during 2027, preferably in summer. The host can be elsewhere in India. The announcement dated 10 September 2026 promises eligible round-trip train fare and a monthly fellowship for living expenses at the host location. It does not publish a fixed amount, so avoid budgeting around an assumed stipend.

About 200 fellowships are planned. Selection information, subject to the guide’s agreement, is expected around March-April 2027. Meeting the eligibility conditions does not guarantee an award.

Prepare the documents and research statement

  1. Scan your marksheets from Class 10 through your latest examination. Each file must be JPEG and no larger than 700 KB.

  2. Write 150-250 words explaining the specific problem, experiment or theory you want to explore and what you hope to learn. Write it yourself rather than copying a general description of the subject.

  3. Student applicants must provide contact details for a current teacher familiar with their work. The Academy contacts that teacher for the recommendation.

  4. Teacher applicants should upload publications, if any. Selected teachers must send the required Principal or HoD permission letter by post.

  5. Use the registration button on the official instructions page and submit one application by 30 November 2026. Keep the assigned registration number for future correspondence.

Multiple applications can invalidate all submissions from the same candidate. Do not send paper applications or marksheets; the separate permission-letter requirement applies to selected teachers. The portal also asks applicants to avoid apostrophes and special scientific characters in form entries.

If your institution or course falls outside these rules, explore other scholarships and fellowships rather than submitting inaccurate details.

Can a student from any Indian college apply?

No. FASTSF 2027 limits eligibility to students and teachers studying or working in the regions named in the official notice. Students also need an eligible course and year.

Is the monthly fellowship amount confirmed?

The official announcement confirms monthly support and eligible return train fare but does not specify the amount.

Do teachers need 65% average marks?

No. The official instructions exempt teachers from the minimum average-marks requirement.

Must the project run only during summer?

The two-month placement can take place during the 2027 calendar year, although summer is preferred. Arrange the timing with the assigned guide.

description:

Match the study to a listed landscape

The official application form groups research themes under Ladakh, Khangchendzonga-Sikkim and Arunachal Pradesh. It asks you to enter the serial number of your preferred theme. Read the description beside that number before choosing it.

Examples include water availability, human-wildlife interactions, restoration ecology and community-forest knowledge. Choose a question you could investigate within a dissertation. A narrow question with a workable method is more useful than a promise to study an entire landscape.

Give each part of the proposal its own job

The form specifies these lengths for the written sections:

Section

Stated length

Background and problem statement

300 words

Study objectives

100 words

Research methods

300 words

Anticipated learning outcomes

250 words

Statement of purpose

200 words

Use the background to explain the problem, objectives to state what you will investigate, and methods to explain how. In the statement of purpose, connect your existing skills and interests to the proposed work. Avoid repeating the same paragraph across sections.

Separate the award from your fieldwork budget

The call offers USD 900 per selected student. It does not label this a monthly payment. Ask ATREE about disbursement before relying on a payment schedule.

The form requests itemised estimates for travel, food and boarding, field assistance and equipment, plus any additional funding. Work from realistic quantities and unit costs. Do not assume that every estimated expense will be reimbursed.

Send the complete application to the programme

Email the application, CV and institutional support letter to ihr.fellowships@atree.org. Follow the official fellowship call for the current instructions. Joint supervision involves ATREE and the home institution; shortlisted applicants may be interviewed.

Check that your attachments open correctly and that your contact details match across files. Retain a copy of what you submit. For other funding choices, use the scholarship directory and compare the eligible study stage before applying.

Application questions

Must I complete the affirmative-action questionnaire?

The form offers a Yes/No choice. Applicants who do not wish to provide that information may choose No.

Where do I explain why this fellowship suits me?

Use the 200-word statement of purpose to connect your background, skills and interests to the fellowship.

Does submitting guarantee selection?

No. An application is considered for selection; it is not an award confirmation.

Will every eligible scholar receive ₹25,000?

description:
The Vidyasamunnathi Graduation Scholarship 2026-27 can help eligible Kerala students with undergraduate study costs. Applications close on 7 November 2026. Before filling the form, check which course category applies to you and whether your college admission meets the scheme rules.

How much support can you receive?

The annual award is ₹8,000 for professional courses and ₹6,000 for non-professional courses. These are amounts for selected beneficiaries, not guaranteed payments to every applicant. The corporation prioritises applicants with lower family income, and awards depend on funding.

Your course and admission route matter

The scheme is for students from non-reserved forward communities in Kerala. Eligible regular, full-time study includes courses at recognised government, aided and self-financing institutions covered by the official graduation guidelines.

For study outside Kerala, the guidelines require admission through an all-India competitive entrance examination and proof of that admission route. They specifically allow Kerala students admitted to medical courses in other states through NEET. Admission through an institution's own entrance examination outside Kerala does not qualify under this condition.

For a five-year integrated course, apply in the graduation category for the first three years. If your college or admission route is unclear, contact Samunnathi on 0471-2311215 or 6238170312 before choosing the category.

  • Annual family income from all sources must be no more than ₹4 lakh.

  • You must not have reached 35 on the date applications are invited. This is not an age test based on the day you submit the form.

  • You need at least 70% marks or an equivalent grade in Plus Two, Higher Secondary or an equivalent examination.

  • You need an active account in your own name at a nationalised or scheduled bank.

The guidelines exclude recipients of other central or state government scholarships or stipends, except e-grantz. The institution certificate also asks the college to certify that you receive no other scholarship or stipend assistance. If you have another award, ask the corporation about your case before obtaining that declaration.

An individual-income certificate is not accepted in place of family-income proof. The family-income certificate must cover the household represented in your ration card. Check that your passbook shows the account number, IFSC and branch clearly.

Graduation scholarship FAQs

Does the ₹8,000 amount apply to every degree course?

Can a Kerala student studying in another state apply?

Should I send the documents by post?

title: Manipur Post-Matric ST Scholarship 2026-27: Deadline and Hostel Rules

description:
Manipur ST students in post-matric study have until 31 October 2026 to submit the 2026-27 scholarship form on NSP. If you plan to claim hosteller support, check the certificate requirement before filling the form. That detail can determine whether the application is accepted.

Who should check this scheme?

The Manipur Directorate of Tribal Affairs and Hills notification covers post-matric study by Scheduled Tribe students belonging to Manipur. It requires study in a government or recognised school, institution or university in India and puts the parental annual income ceiling at ₹2.5 lakh. The notification excludes students at government institutions that are fully funded and provide free education, boarding, lodging and other educational facilities. Check your exact course and institution in the National Scholarship Portal before applying. Students seeking pre-matric support should use our separate Manipur pre-matric ST scholarship guide.

The hosteller decision matters

Do not mark yourself as a hosteller just because you rent a room near campus. The state notification requires a certificate from the head of the institution for the qualifying hostel arrangement. It also describes conditions for institution-approved accommodation outside a campus hostel. Ask your institution whether your arrangement meets those conditions and whether it will issue the certificate before you choose a status in NSP. The notification warns that an application without the required institutional certificate can be rejected.

Student submission and verification are different deadlines

The government notice sets 31 October 2026 as the last date for student applications. It allows institute verification and correction of defective applications until 20 November 2026. This is not an extension of the student application window. The notice says the dates will not be extended. Submit early enough to correct an error if your institution flags one.

Before you submit on NSP

Prepare your ST and income documents, course and institution details, and a bank account seeded with Aadhaar and enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer, as required by the state notice. Use a mobile number and email address that you can access during verification. Open the official NSP student page, complete the application, and save the acknowledgement. Then watch its status and respond quickly if the institution marks a defect. We have not quoted an award amount here because the state’s current notice does not set out a single amount applicable to every applicant.

Questions students ask

Can I submit a new application after 31 October because verification runs until November?

No. The 20 November date is for institute verification and correction of defective applications. Students should submit by 31 October 2026.

Does a private rented room count as hostel accommodation?

Not automatically. Check the state’s conditions for approved accommodation with your institution and obtain the required certificate before claiming hosteller status.

Where should I apply?

Use the official NSP student portal, not a third-party form. Verify that the Manipur post-matric ST scheme and your institution are shown for your application.

title: AICTE Swanath Scholarship 2026-27: ₹50,000 Support and 31 October Deadline

eligibility: AICTE Swanath is for a student in a regular AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma course who falls in one of the specified circumstances: orphanhood; a parent dying of COVID-19; being the ward of armed forces or central paramilitary personnel martyred in action; or a parent with a critical life-threatening disease, or who died or became more than 80% disabled in an accident. description:
For a student already managing a difficult family situation, the AICTE Swanath scheme can make an approved technical course more affordable. Who should check eligibility?

The AICTE guideline sets four alternative family circumstances: an orphan; a student whose parent or parents died because of COVID-19; a ward of armed forces or central paramilitary personnel martyred in action; or a student whose parent has a critical life-threatening disease, or died or became severely disabled (above 80%) in an accident. Meeting one circumstance is only the beginning. Family income must be at most ₹8 lakh per year, the student must study a regular AICTE-approved degree or diploma course, and they must not receive another central, state or AICTE scholarship.

This means two students in the same college may get different answers. Check the institution’s AICTE approval and the evidence needed for your own category before spending time on the form. The guideline calls for a valid state or UT income certificate.

What does ₹50,000 cover?

AICTE specifies a lump sum of ₹50,000 per academic year for selected students. It can support college fees and study needs such as books, equipment, software and a computer. The maximum period is four years for a degree student who entered in the first year, or three years for a diploma student who entered in the first year; a later-year applicant has fewer remaining supported years. There is no separate hostel or medical grant under this scheme. Selection is limited; meeting eligibility does not guarantee an award.

How to apply without confusing the deadlines

  1. Find the degree or diploma Swanath scheme on the official NSP listing and read the guideline linked there.

  2. Prepare the category evidence, income certificate and institution details required for your case.

  3. Submit the student application through NSP by 31 October 2026 and retain the acknowledgement.

  4. Monitor the application: the host institution verifies it first, followed by the state or UT technical-education department.

NSP lists later dates for defective-application and institutional verification. Those are not an extension of the 31 October student deadline. For other funding routes, browse DekhoCampus scholarships, but compare overlap rules before applying for another award.

The official 2027 call gives a PhD-defence window of December 2021 to December 2026 inclusive. Applicants must be exclusively of foreign nationality, with French nationality excluded, and seek an international move to France. The call excludes applicants residing and professionally active in France at application time and anyone who has already held a MOPGA fellowship.

A maternity-leave exception may extend the doctoral eligibility period by 18 months per child or the actual leave duration, with supporting evidence. If that affects your eligibility, include the documents and seek clarification from Campus France before submitting.

Ask the host about resources, not just a signature

Send a focused project outline to a suitable laboratory. Explain the question, method and facilities you would need. MOPGA supports environmental and climate-related research, including earth systems, sustainability, energy transition and societal questions. A One Health proposal must connect human, animal and ecosystem health; a solely medical project without those wider dimensions does not qualify.

The host supervisor’s support letter must be co-signed by the laboratory director or accompanied by the director’s commitment letter. It should confirm the necessary scientific environment and resources. You also need the supervisor’s CV, limited to two pages. Discuss equipment, data access and laboratory costs before assuming that the fellowship will pay for them.

Build a budget around what is actually funded

The award pays €2,500 monthly for 12 months and a €500 settling-in allowance, with the health and liability coverage described in the official call. It is not renewable. International travel and laboratory costs are not covered by the programme; ask the host whether separate help is available.

The fellowship cannot be combined with a French employment contract or other individual funding from a French government entity. Clarify any overlapping offer before accepting commitments.

Prepare the online file

  • Your CV with publications, no more than four pages.

  • Your doctoral certificate or the official proof accepted by Campus France.

  • The host supervisor’s CV and the required laboratory support letters.

  • One to three recommendation letters.

  • A passport or national identity document.

Write the project sections within the form’s character limits, including spaces. The methodology and timeline section permits up to 4,500 characters; the summary, background, objectives, MOPGA relevance and international-impact sections each permit up to 2,000. Applications may be in English or French.

Use the official application guide while preparing the file, then submit through the Campus France application platform. Email submissions are not accepted. Results are scheduled for May-June 2027, with research stays beginning between September and December 2027. Selection is competitive, so an application is not a funding confirmation.

Applicants still choosing their next study stage can compare other opportunities in the scholarship directory.

Questions before you submit

Can I use MOPGA to fund a master’s degree or PhD?

No. This call is for eligible early-career researchers undertaking a research stay after their doctoral defence, not a master’s or doctoral degree scholarship.

What if my doctoral certificate has not been issued?

Consult the proof-of-degree guidance in the official call. Obtain an institutional document confirming your defence and ask Campus France if the document you can provide meets its requirements.

Will the monthly allowance pay my flight to France?

International travel is outside the programme’s covered costs. Arrange a separate travel budget or ask the host laboratory whether it can help.

title: Vidyasamunnathi Coaching Assistance 2026-27: Bank, PSC and SSC Rules
provider: Kerala State Welfare Corporation for Forward Communities
amount: Coaching-fee reimbursement up to ₹6,000
eligibility:
Applicants must belong to a non-reserved forward community of Kerala, have annual family income below ₹4 lakh and attend eligible classroom coaching for Bank, SSC, PSC, UPSC examinations other than Civil Services, or other competitive examinations. They must hold the qualification required for their chosen examination and an active savings account in their own name at a nationalised or scheduled bank.

Online coaching is excluded. The institute must hold the required local-authority licence or operate under the Companies Act. Previous recipients of this competitive-exam coaching assistance cannot apply again.
description:
If you are attending classroom coaching for a competitive examination, Vidyasamunnathi can reimburse eligible fees up to ₹6,000. The Kerala State Welfare Corporation for Forward Communities has set 7 November 2026 as the application deadline for 2026-27. This category does not cover online coaching or Civil Services coaching.

Check the exam and the coaching institute first

The official competitive-exam guidelines cover Bank, SSC, PSC, UPSC examinations other than Civil Services, and other competitive examinations. You must already have the basic educational qualification required for the examination you are preparing for.

You must be attending coaching in person at an eligible institute. The institute must have the appropriate local self-government licence or operate under the Companies Act. An online course does not qualify, even if it prepares students for an otherwise eligible examination.

Civil Services has a separate coaching-assistance category. Students taking vocational courses longer than one year are directed to the Vidyasamunnathi scholarship scheme; applicants to that scheme cannot also claim this coaching assistance.

Family income, previous awards and reimbursement

Applicants must belong to a non-reserved forward community of Kerala. Annual family income must be below ₹4 lakh. The income certificate must record family income, rather than only an individual's earnings.

The payment reimburses coaching fees already paid, up to the ₹6,000 limit. It is not an automatic flat payment to everyone who applies. Lower-income applicants receive priority, and final selection depends on available funds. Those who have previously received this competitive-exam coaching assistance from the corporation are not eligible to apply again.

Use an active savings account in your own name at a nationalised or scheduled bank. Check the account number, branch and IFSC against your passbook before submitting.

Ask your institute for the correct certificate

Download the 2026-27 coaching certificate. It asks the institute to confirm the exam category and qualification level, duration of coaching, and fees paid during January to December 2026. The head of the institute or authorised signatory must sign it, add a phone number and office seal, and record the institute's recognition and registration details.

Prepare readable scans of these documents for the online form:

  • Caste proof: the Village Officer's certificate recording caste, or the SSLC page carrying the caste entry.

  • The Village Officer's family-income certificate in the name of the applicant, parent or guardian listed in the ration card containing the applicant.

  • The prescribed coaching-institute certificate.

  • The first page of your bank passbook, with payment details clearly readable.

  • Pages 1 and 2 of the ration card containing your name.

  • The qualification certificate for the relevant examination and a copy of your SSLC certificate.

Keep your original coaching-fee receipt. For shortlisted applicants, the guidelines require the original receipt for fees paid between 1 January and 31 December 2026, carrying the institute's GST registration number. Do not treat the end of that receipt period as an extension of the application deadline.

Submit online, then watch for a shortlist message

Open the official Samunnathi application portal. New users should register and complete their profile; existing users can use their registered username and password. Select the correct coaching category, attach the scans and submit by 7 November. Keep a copy of the completed application.

Do not post the application and documents immediately after submitting online. Only shortlisted applicants who receive an SMS or email should send the requested papers, including the application copy and original fee receipt, to the corporation. Follow the instructions in that message. The guidelines give the postal address as Kerala State Welfare Corporation for Forward Communities Ltd, L2, Kuleena, Jawahar Nagar, Kowdiar P.O., Thiruvananthapuram-3.

Incomplete applications, incorrect information or unclear documents can lead to rejection. For a question about your institute or documents, contact Samunnathi on 0471-2311215 or 6238170312 before submitting.

Coaching assistance FAQs

Can I claim assistance for an online bank-exam course?

No. These guidelines exclude online coaching. The applicant must attend eligible coaching in person.

Does this ₹6,000 category include UPSC Civil Services?

No. It covers UPSC examinations other than Civil Services. Check the separate Civil Services category on the official guidelines page.

Can I apply again if I received this assistance before?

No. Previous recipients of this competitive-exam coaching assistance from the corporation are excluded.

When should I send my original fee receipt by post?

Send it only if you are shortlisted and receive the corporation's SMS or email requesting documents. The receipt must carry the institute's GST registration number.

If you are seeking course-fee support rather than coaching reimbursement, check the separate Vidyasamunnathi diploma scholarship or browse the scholarship directory.

title: Sakal India Foundation Scholarship 2026-27: New Applications Close 31 October
amount: ₹5,000 to ₹10,000 by study level
eligibility:

What the grant can contribute

The foundation publishes ₹5,000 for Class 11, ₹5,000 for Class 12, ₹8,000 for graduation and ₹10,000 for postgraduate study. Diploma study is listed among the supported courses, but a separate diploma award is not specified in the amount section. Diploma applicants should ask the foundation which amount applies to their course.

The award is a grant for one year. Current beneficiaries can seek renewal until postgraduate study is complete. Each continuation application still needs to follow the foundation’s process; admission to a course alone does not guarantee an award or renewal.

Prepare your application before signing in

Keep a clear copy of your latest marksheet, confirmed-admission evidence and family income proof. The official document list also asks for photographs, co-curricular and extracurricular certificates, and Aadhaar and PAN documents for the student and parent or guardian. Go to the Sakal India Foundation scholarship portal. New users can register; existing users can sign in. Select the route appropriate to your applicant status and complete the requested details and uploads. Retain any acknowledgement or application reference the portal provides.

The application is examined by an expert committee, followed by the trustees’ final assessment. The programme page requires family income proof but does not state a fixed income ceiling. Do not assume that a threshold used by another scholarship applies here.

For questions about course coverage, documents or continuation, contact the foundation on 020 66035935 or contactus@sakalindiafoundation.org. You can also compare other options in the DekhoCampus scholarship directory.

Is 31 March 2027 the deadline for a new application?

No. The official 2026-27 panel lists 31 October 2026 for new students. The 31 March 2027 date belongs to the continuation window for existing beneficiaries.

Does every selected student receive ₹10,000?

No. The listed amount depends on study level: ₹5,000 for Class 11 or 12, ₹8,000 for graduation and ₹10,000 for postgraduate study. A separate diploma amount is not published in the amount section.

Can students outside Maharashtra assume they qualify?

No. Although Indian residency appears in the general eligibility criteria, the programme page identifies the supported school, diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate categories as being in Maharashtra. Applicants outside that coverage should obtain clarification from the foundation.

Is there a published maximum family income?

The programme page requires family income proof and describes support for financially disadvantaged students, but it does not give a numerical ceiling. Ask the foundation about your circumstances instead of applying an unsupported limit.

Will the grant continue automatically throughout the course?

No automatic continuation is promised. The grant is for one year, and current beneficiaries can renew through postgraduate level using the foundation’s continuation process.
